chunks: Then they would not be able to make a will, or go back to their people.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people on the Day of Judgment regarding their wills and families?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the abruptness of death, illustrating how the soul is severed from worldly ties without the opportunity to settle debts or distribute inheritance. It serves as a poignant reminder of the urgency in fulfilling one's religious and familial duties before the inevitable return to the Creator.
